Name: CJB Season Filter
Author: RoyJ549
Description:
CJB Season Filter is a lightweight companion mod for CJB Item Spawner that adds seasonal filtering to the Seeds category.

If you use expansion mods or large crop packs, the seed list can get crowded very quickly. This mod lets you filter seeds by growing season without changing CJB Item Spawner's normal spawning, searching, or browsing behavior.


[b]INSTALLATION[/b]

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Install CJB Item Spawner.
3. Download CJB Season Filter.
4. Extract the CJBSeasonFilter folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
5. Launch the game through SMAPI.

No configuration is required.


MAIN FEATURES

• Filter seeds by All, Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter, Multi-season, or Special.

• Use the left and right arrows for quick switching, or click the current season label to open the full dropdown menu.

• Seasonal filtering works together with CJB Item Spawner's existing search.

• Multi-season crops appear in every matching season as well as under Multi-season.

• Supports English and Simplified Chinese.

• Designed to work with both the standard CJB interface and visual interface overhauls.


AUTOMATIC SUPPORT FOR MODDED CROPS

CJB Season Filter does not use hardcoded compatibility lists.

Instead, it reads the final loaded Stardew Valley 1.6 Data/Crops asset after other mods have applied their changes.

This means most crop mods using the standard Stardew Valley 1.6 data system should work automatically, including crop packs and expansion mods that CJB Season Filter has never been specifically updated for.

The mod was developed and tested in a heavily modded setup including Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, and Cornucopia.

Compatibility comes from the crop data itself rather than per-mod patches.


SPECIAL SEEDS

Some seed-like items do not have standard crop season data.

Instead of hiding them, CJB Season Filter keeps them accessible and places them under Special when they cannot be reliably classified.

Fruit tree saplings are not treated as ordinary seasonal crops because their season data has a different meaning from normal crop growth seasons.


REQUIREMENTS

• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI
• CJB Item Spawner

CJB Item Spawner must be installed separately.

CJB Season Filter is an independent companion mod and does not include or redistribute CJB Item Spawner.


COMPATIBILITY

Developed and tested with:

Stardew Valley 1.6.15
SMAPI 4.5.2
CJB Item Spawner 2.5.6

Most standard Stardew Valley 1.6 crop mods should work automatically.

Mods which implement crops through completely custom systems may not expose enough season information for automatic classification. Their seeds may appear under Special instead.


KNOWN LIMITATIONS

Major internal changes to future versions of CJB Item Spawner may require an update to CJB Season Filter.

Non-standard custom crops without usable Data/Crops information cannot always be classified automatically.

Fruit tree saplings are intentionally excluded from ordinary crop-season classification.

If you find a crop that is classified incorrectly, please include the crop mod name and seed item when reporting it.


SHOUT OUTS

Thanks to ConcernedApe, Pathoschild, and the Stardew Valley / SMAPI modding community for the game, framework, tools, and documentation that make projects like this possible.


AI-ASSISTED DEVELOPMENT

This project was developed with assistance from OpenAI Codex and AI coding models.

The implementation was reviewed, compiled, tested, and validated in the actual Stardew Valley mod environment before release.
